reviews.text: Andrew did a great job doing stacked stone on my fireplace and hanging the tv, sound bar, and mantle. He has also done numerous other smaller projects and all have turned out well. His drywall repair and patching is great. We enjoy working with him and will use him for future projects.
reviews.author: Susan Gaydosh

reviews.text: I am so impressed with the work Andrew has done in our home.  He’s helped me out with the installation of new light fixtures, hanging gas heaters out on our patio and with designing a custom tiled dog shower in our garage.  Andrew is very professional, does amazing, fast work and is always on time and willing to squeeze me in to his schedule.  I would definitely recommend Andrew and Bend River Handyman!
reviews.author: Amy Zamuner

reviews.text: Bend river handyman repaired drywall, hung ceiling fans throughout the house, mounted 2 flat screen TVs on articulating mounts and build a deck for our hot tub. Andrew is Such a hard worker and very is easy to get along with! He made the process easy and fun we will be calling again soon!
reviews.author: Bobbi Hill

reviews.text: Andrew did a great job mounting our TV on a swing arm and installing a new kitchen faucet.  He was prompt and efficient.  I will definitely call him again and highly recommend him.
reviews.author: Robert Lacombe

reviews.text: Hired Andrew to install lightbulbs in high vaulted ceilings and repair a pocket door. He was late arriving for his appointment but did a good job installing all the new can lights and bulbs. However, he did not allow enough time at this appointment to repair the pocket door nor did he give me date when he would be able to do it.
reviews.author: Catherine Brooks
